verdict.rationale: A tax agency with online filing and rate-lookup services could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so the axis applies. The evidence shows none: all probed OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404, and the documentation describes only web-portal (My DOR), mail and phone workflows. The transactional portal sits behind a login wall, so a spec hosted there could not be checked, which keeps confidence at medium.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
